name: Conjure Constructs

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Intangible Construct spirits gather beside a creature you choose within 60 feet. When you cast it and as a Magic action later, they act on a creature within 5 feet of them: an enemy makes a Dexterity save against 3d6 Force damage (half on a success); an ally gains 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier Temporary Hit Points. When you move on your turn you can move the spirits up to 30 feet too. Both rolls gain 1d6 per slot level above 3.
